identity.name: Historiques American 1921
identity.one_liner: The driver's watch revival — cushion case, dial rotated 45 degrees, crown at 1 o'clock, exactly as in 1921.

narrative.story: In the early 1920s Vacheron built a small run of cushion-cased watches for the American market with the dial turned 45 degrees, so a driver could read the time with hands on the wheel. The Historiques American 1921, introduced in 2008 at 40mm, reproduces the idea faithfully: offset crown at 1 o'clock, rotated Breguet-numeral dial, manual caliber 4400 AS visible through the back. The line's centenary in 2021 brought new sizes and a platinum piece, but the rose gold 82035 remains the definitive configuration.
narrative.collector_notes: It wears differently than anything else at this level and photographs deceptively large for 40mm — try before buying. Check the enamel-style printing on the dial for touch-ups; the exposed caseback makes movement condition easy to verify.
